249506301.name: Quality of Life
249506301.thought: A marker sketch on Sunday. Thirty thousand visitors by Thursday.
249506301.line: A stand drawn as a courtyard: open corners, a ring of red, a quiet centre where people sat down and stayed.

250404065.name: Ramadan Nights
250404065.thought: The city sleeps late in Ramadan. So the render was lit for midnight.
250404065.line: Arches, lanterns and a crescent you could walk under. Daylight white model first, then the night it was built for.

248381303.name: Misk Schools
248381303.thought: Three arches, one tree, and a schools fair that felt like a park.
248381303.line: The stand had no walls, only canopies. Children ran under it, parents followed, teachers stayed.

248713431.name: National Day 95
248713431.thought: A village for one night, from the gate to the food carts.
248713431.line: Green and red patterns scaled up to the size of a street. Stages, carts, games, a horse. Nothing in the render stayed on the screen.

247988533.name: Founding Day
247988533.thought: Mud walls, lanterns and the smell of coffee, drawn before any of it existed.
247988533.line: Gates, columns and a pottery wall in sand tones. Built to look like it had always been there.

247691629.name: Financial Academy
247691629.thought: A ribbon of a stand, folded until it stood on its own.
247691629.line: One continuous surface, lit from the edges, with a screen where the fold opened. Then the real one on the show floor.

249047033.name: World Defense Show
249047033.thought: A trophy is a room you can hold.
249047033.line: Glass, brass and the show's geometry, cut so the light does the engraving.

249270879.name: Biban Invitation
249270879.thought: An invitation you open like a gift and keep like a secret.
249270879.line: A tin box with a window, a badge, a lanyard and a card. The event started the moment it arrived.

247703285.name: Local Content Forum
247703285.thought: A whole outdoor district drawn in a week.

247700385.name: Court of Audit Trophy
